title: PUT /v0.1/spheres/{sphere}/public/{linkId}, and …/page
description: What the Obysphere now serves for a public link (spec/sphere-api.md section 11): the SHA-256 and size of the ciphertext it keeps, or of the page the owner's client uploaded, which that client checks against what /a/{linkId} serves; when the link expires; and its URL on the Obysphere's public origin, without the key, which the client adds after '#'. Comes with the feature public_links.

link_id.description: The link's id, its owner's client's choice, unique on the server: /a/{linkId}.

expires.description: When the link stops being served, unless its owner puts it up again: at most 30 days on.

url.description: The link without its key: the public origin's /a/{linkId}. No query and no '#'.
